exposure_note: I have no inherited parent conversation turns. My runtime context did include the user-provided AGENTS.md handoff text and environment/instruction context, including aggregate historical research results; this is project-background exposure, so this is not a claim of complete project-context blindness. I did not open AGENTS.md or repository history, predictions, source specification, coordinator mapping, previous item judgments, generated answers, probe results, authored condition labels, original IDs, or another reviewer output. Task data accessed from disk were only input_public/rubric.json and input_public/packet.json. I read the rubric and all 40 questions and all 200 complete document slots through eight untruncated five-item pages, judging only supplied item evidence. I used a temporary writing/validation helper under /tmp and my designated output directory. Related text recurred across items, but each rating uses only the evidence in that item. This is an LLM evidence-semantics review, not independent human gold.
